name: Utage ~Urei no Yakata~
source:
Main character inherits an old hotel on the hill of a small island. A lot of strange people have booking there. According to his deceased novelist uncle will, protagonist will lose inheritance rights unless he finds the unpublished uncle's novel. Main character will need to get along the inhabitants of this place to approach the secret about this place and hidden novel.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公继承了小岛上山丘上的一栋古老旅馆。许多奇怪的人都预订了那里。根据他已故小说家叔叔的遗嘱，除非找到叔叔未出版的小说，否则他将失去继承权。主人公需要与这个地方的居民们搞好关系，以接近关于这个地方和隐藏小说的秘密。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
